note: Source of truth for the toolset. Evidence labels follow vault/SCHEMA.md. verified-upstream means the command or behavior is in linked official docs. untested means no run in this kit yet.

components.name: Contract-test runner
components.purpose: Run synthetic suites and live jobs through adapters and save evidence.
use_when: Always. Every other component is tested through it.
components.proves: An adapter returns the expected status, exit code, metrics, and artifacts for a fixture.
components.does_not_prove: That the wrapped tool is correct on real data.
components.hermes_surface: CI step, pre-commit hook, or a no-agent cron script

synthetic_cases.input: Document with all required keys
Document missing two keys
A JSON list

components.sample_job: examples/reference/job.json: check a real config file for required keys.

components.name: Hermes session export
components.purpose: Produce a stable JSONL record of sessions, messages, and tool calls for offline scoring.
use_when: A gate needs the tool-call sequence of a Hermes run.
No trace backend is installed yet.
avoid_when: You need live dashboards or cost tracking across many runs. Add langfuse-trace.
components.proves: Which tools a session called, in which order.
components.does_not_prove: That the session's output was correct.

synthetic_cases.input: A scripted session with three known tool calls
A session ID that does not exist

components.sample_job: Export yesterday's sessions for one profile and count tool calls per session.

components.name: Langfuse tracing via the Hermes plugin
components.purpose: Record turns, LLM calls, tool calls, tokens, and cost for every run.
use_when: You need to see what an agent did across many runs.
You need cost or latency per turn.
You want failed sessions to become dataset items.
avoid_when: You need to block anything. The plugin is fail-open.
The data includes minors or private content and capture mode has not been set to metadata.
components.proves: That a run produced the expected trace shape without leaking planted canaries.
components.does_not_prove: That traces are complete. A full queue, failed export, or abrupt kill can lose telemetry.
components.gate_type: fail-open observer. The adapter checks trace presence and fails closed on its own.
components.hermes_surface: Plugin: hermes plugins install langfuse; HERMES_LANGFUSE_BASE_URL for self-hosted; HERMES_LANGFUSE_CAPTURE=metadata|sanitized|full

synthetic_cases.input: Scripted session: 1 turn, 1 generation, 3 tool calls, 3 planted canaries, capture metadata
Same session with keys unset
synthetic_cases.expected: error, NO_TRACE. Hermes itself still completes the turn.

synthetic_cases.input: Capture full with a canary in the prompt

components.sample_job: Nightly: summarize yesterday's traces per session (model, tool calls, tokens, cost) into the vault inbox.

components.name: Pairwise fixture generation (allpairspy)
components.purpose: Generate a small fixture set that covers every pair of input variations for a parser or form.
use_when: An input has several independent dimensions (format, encoding, blanks, quoting).
Exhaustive combinations are too many to keep.
avoid_when: Faults depend on three or more factors at once. Use n-wise or targeted cases.
The input has one or two dimensions. Write the cases by hand.
components.proves: That the code under test handles each generated fixture as its expected.json says.
components.does_not_prove: Optimal coverage. The upstream project calls its output good enough, not optimal.
components.hermes_surface: Pre-commit hook or CI step. Fixture folders are read-only to the coding agent.

synthetic_cases.input: 5 dimensions with known values
synthetic_cases.expected: pass, every value pair appears at least once

synthetic_cases.input: Fixture with a row missing columns
synthetic_cases.expected: block, readable row error, no stack trace

synthetic_cases.input: Zero-byte file

components.sample_job: Pre-commit: run the parser over the golden fixture folder and fail on any mismatch.

components.name: Trajectory scoring (DeepEval ToolCorrectnessMetric)
components.purpose: Score whether a run called the expected tools, optionally in order.
use_when: A task has a verified procedure with a known tool sequence.
You see loops, skipped steps, or extra tool calls.
avoid_when: Open-ended feature work where many sequences are valid. Score outcomes instead.
You need an LLM judge to run offline. Leave available_tools unset to keep the score deterministic.
components.proves: Tool names, and optionally order or exact match, against a golden list.
components.does_not_prove: That the final output is right. Pair with the project's own tests.
components.gate_type: deterministic when available_tools is not passed
components.hermes_surface: CI step on each agent-authored PR, reading an exported session

synthetic_cases.input: Golden [read_file, edit_file, run_tests]; same trace
read_file six times, then the golden sequence
Golden without run_tests

components.sample_job: CI: score the session attached to each PR and post score and reason as a comment.

components.name: Domain metric slot (example: TrackEval for multi-object tracking)
components.purpose: Score a model pipeline with the field's standard metric instead of a generic one.
use_when: The project outputs something a field already measures: tracks, retrieval, detection, transcription.
You need regression checks per category.
avoid_when: No labeled ground truth exists yet. Build it first.
components.proves: Metric movement on planted faults in the expected direction.
components.does_not_prove: Accuracy on real footage until labeled real data passes.
components.hermes_surface: Cron job or CI step over a labeled golden folder

synthetic_cases.input: Tracker output identical to ground truth
IDs swapped halfway
Frames numbered from 0

components.sample_job: Watch the golden folder for new labeled clips, score them, append per-clip metrics to a CSV.

components.name: Human agreement and judge calibration (Cohen's kappa, Rogan-Gladen)
components.purpose: Check that people agree on a label before tuning a model or judge to it, then correct observed rates for known detector error.
use_when: A label is subjective (a coaching call, a rubric score).
An LLM judge or detector reports a rate you plan to act on.
avoid_when: More than two annotators. sklearn kappa covers two.
Detector sensitivity and specificity are unknown or sum to 1. The correction is undefined.
components.proves: Whether a label is measurable, and a corrected prevalence under stated error rates.
components.does_not_prove: That the corrected rate transfers to new data with different error rates.
components.hermes_surface: Agent task that reads two label exports and writes a vault note

synthetic_cases.input: Confusion matrix rows (48, 2) and (3, 47)
Confusion matrix rows (60, 20) and (20, 0), 60% raw agreement
Observed 0.41, sensitivity 0.9, specificity 0.8
Sensitivity 0.5, specificity 0.5

components.sample_job: Compare two reviewers' tag exports, compute kappa per label, flag any label below threshold.

components.name: Runtime guard (Hermes pre_tool_call shell hook, fail-closed)
components.purpose: Block a specific risky tool call while the agent runs, not after.
use_when: A tool call must never happen: writing fixtures, touching credentials, deleting outside the workdir.
CI is too late to stop the harm.
avoid_when: The rule is a quality score. Score it in CI.
The hook is slow. Default timeout is 60 seconds, capped at 300.
components.proves: That a planted forbidden call is blocked and an allowed call proceeds.
components.does_not_prove: Coverage of calls the matcher does not match.
components.hermes_surface: Shell hook in the profile config.yaml; verify with hermes hooks test and hermes hooks doctor

synthetic_cases.input: Synthetic pre_tool_call payload for an allowed path
Payload that edits a read-only fixture folder
Hook script that exits non-zero with no directive

components.sample_job: Guard the golden fixture folders in every coding session.

components.name: Failure harvesting
components.purpose: Turn gate failures and human corrections into reviewable candidate fixtures.
use_when: At least one gate is admitted and producing failures.
You want regressions to become permanent tests.
avoid_when: No gate is admitted yet. There is nothing to harvest.
Promotion would be automatic. Promotion stays with the operator.
components.proves: That failures are deduplicated, scrubbed of secrets and personal data, and queued for review.
components.does_not_prove: That a harvested case is a correct golden. A person decides.
components.gate_type: deterministic scrub and dedupe; human promotion
components.hermes_surface: Weekly cron that lists pending cases in the vault inbox
